rules.new_licensee_rule: License issued within one year of the renewal date: no CE for the first renewal; otherwise 15 hours (8 clinical/science-based).
rules.audit_note: Compliance audits after each license period; keep certificates for two renewal periods (DPO page says 4 years); do not send unless requested.
rules.accepted_credit_types: ADA CERP; AGD PACE; AMA; CODA-accredited institutions; ADHA and its constituents/components; ACPE; CDC ANSI courses; dental/medical professional organizations or study groups; non-accredited courses need Board pre-approval
rules.notes: At least 16 h clinical/science-based; at least 50% live and interactive (live webinars count). Current BLS required (max 2 h credit). Annual OSHA bloodborne pathogen training. Presenting max 6 h.
